name: How to Convert PDF to Markdown
description: Extract text, headings and lists from a PDF into a clean .md file — 100% in your browser.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose file' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Let PDFree detect structure
step.text: Headings, bullet lists, numbered lists and bold/italic text are detected automatically.

step.name: Download the .md file
step.text: Click 'Convert to Markdown'. A plain-text Markdown file downloads immediately.
